questions.stem: An analytics engineer maintains a lightweight transformation that is referenced by only two downstream models. The transformation is currently materialized as ephemeral to reduce clutter in the data warehouse. A new governance policy requires this transformation to enforce a model contract so that its column names and data types are guaranteed to downstream consumers. What should the engineer do?

option_texts.A: Configure an enforced contract in the model's YAML and leave the materialization as ephemeral
option_texts.B: Configure the model to materialize as a view or table, because ephemeral does not support model contracts
option_texts.C: Configure a model alias on the ephemeral model so the contract binds to the generated CTE identifier
option_texts.D: Configure the enforced contract on each of the two downstream models that consume this transformation

questions.drill_answer_short: Ephemeral materialization doesn't support model contracts. Ephemeral models are not directly built into the database; dbt interpolates the code from an ephemeral model into its dependent models using a common table expression.
questions.drill_rationale: Ephemeral materialization doesn't support model contracts. Ephemeral models are not directly built into the database; dbt interpolates the code from an ephemeral model into its dependent models using a common table expression.
questions.decision_hinge: Ephemeral materialization doesn't support model contracts. Ephemeral models are not directly built into the database; dbt interpolates the code from an ephemeral model into its dependent models using a common table expression.

plausible_options.D: requires this transformation to enforce a model contract so that its column names and data types are guaranteed to downstream consumers

A.signal: The transformation is currently materialized as ephemeral to reduce clutter in the data warehouse
A.requires_fact: Ephemeral materialization doesn't support model contracts.

C.signal: The transformation is currently materialized as ephemeral to reduce clutter in the data warehouse
C.requires_fact: You can control the identifier for this CTE using a model alias

distractor_traps.A: T1: pairs a real config with a materialization that cannot accept it — the combination does not exist
distractor_traps.C: T2: a model alias controls the CTE identifier, which is a naming concern, not a contract-enforcement mechanism
distractor_traps.D: T8: scope error — contracting the consumers guarantees their columns, not this transformation's
